cars_deactivation_chk.name: cars_deactivation_chk
cars_deactivation_chk.value: "cars"."status" <> 'deactivated' OR ("cars"."deactivation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "cars"."deactivated_at" IS NOT NULL)

promotions_dates_chk.name: promotions_dates_chk
promotions_dates_chk.value: "promotions"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "promotions"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "promotions"."ends_on" >= "promotions"."starts_on"
